closing.summary: Big strengths are magnesium, protein, and vitamin E, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low fat quality, and low protein quality. It is good for blood and oxygen support, bone health, and immune support because iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, calcium and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, and vitamin C and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
